newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Dec S&P 500s finish higher, but off peak.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Dec S&P 500s finish higher, but off peak.

text.p: Sept 16 - U.S. December S&P 500s finished higher but off the day's peak once long liquidation materialized. Dec fell just shy of the 695.00 contract high before scaling back. Traders said 693.60 to 694.20 saw brisk trading with dealers on both sides. "We were going for it and going for it, but we just ran out of steam," an S&P 500 trader said.
